summary: Added the Experimenter Control Tower subagent, registered it for Codex delegation, and updated Tower routing so long-running local process execution and monitoring routes to Experimenter while Builder and Scribe retain their existing responsibilities.
work_completed: Added enabled experimenter registry entry with role process-orchestration, backend codex, workspace-write sandbox, search false, and dangerously_bypass true.
Created Experimenter prompt and policy files following the existing agent style.
Encoded Experimenter responsibilities for Infinigen, Blender/FBX export, Unreal import, SPEAR cook/package, flythrough/video, and simulator validation jobs.
Added hard tmux requirements: every long-running or user-observable process must run in a named tmux session/window and report the exact attach command.
Added run-directory, durable logging, monitoring, orphan cleanup, product-code edit restriction, and ResultPacket handoff instructions.

Updated Tower default routing and session behavior with Experimenter process routing and the exact delegation forms: tower-run create-packet experimenter and tower-run delegate experimenter --packet <path>.
Verified .control-tower/state/agent-registry.json parses as JSON with python -m json.tool.
Verified tower-run can create an experimenter packet without registry errors using --output /tmp/experimenter-packet-smoke.json.

findings.message: No product source, tests, examples, or durable docs were edited.
.control-tower/agents/tower/prompt.md already had unrelated uncommitted Git authorization edits before this task; this task preserved them and only added Experimenter routing/session guidance.
An existing untracked task packet .control-tower/packets/outbox/builder-add-experimenter-agent.json was left untouched.

follow_up_recommendations: Tower can optionally ask Scribe to record the new Experimenter routing in operational memory if durable memory curation is desired.
memory_worthy: Control Tower now has an Experimenter agent for long-running local process orchestration; Tower should route Infinigen, Unreal import/cook/package, flythrough/video, and simulator runtime validation process execution to Experimenter using tower-run create-packet experimenter and tower-run delegate experimenter --packet <path>.
